Who is Luciano Burti?

Luciano Pucci Burti (born March 5, 1975 in São Paulo) is a Brazilian former F1 driver, who first competed in 2000 as a substitute for Eddie Irvine and then took part in most races of the 2001 season for and respectively.

His 2001 season is known for being riddled with crashes;

Burti has also been a test driver at from to .
